clubs_name_ru_review_consistency_check.name: clubs_name_ru_review_consistency_check
clubs_name_ru_review_consistency_check.value:
(
        ("football"."clubs"."name_ru" is null and "football"."clubs"."name_ru_review_status" is null)
        or
        (
          "football"."clubs"."name_ru" is not null
          and "football"."clubs"."name_ru_review_status" is not null
          and "football"."clubs"."name_ru_review_status" in ('unreviewed', 'reviewed')
        )
      )

coaches_name_ru_review_consistency_check.name: coaches_name_ru_review_consistency_check
coaches_name_ru_review_consistency_check.value:
(
    ("football"."coaches"."name_ru" is null and "football"."coaches"."name_ru_review_status" is null) or
    ("football"."coaches"."name_ru" is not null and btrim("football"."coaches"."name_ru") <> '' and "football"."coaches"."name_ru_review_status" is not null
      and "football"."coaches"."name_ru_review_status" in ('unreviewed','reviewed')))

coaches_profile_source_check.name: coaches_profile_source_check
coaches_profile_source_check.value:
(
    ("football"."coaches"."profile_observed_at" is null and "football"."coaches"."provider_raw" is null) or
    ("football"."coaches"."profile_observed_at" is not null and "football"."coaches"."provider_raw" is not null
      and jsonb_typeof("football"."coaches"."provider_raw") = 'object' and "football"."coaches"."provider_name" is not null))

competitions_name_ru_review_consistency_.name: competitions_name_ru_review_consistency_check
competitions_name_ru_review_consistency_.value:
(
        ("football"."competitions"."name_ru" is null and "football"."competitions"."name_ru_review_status" is null)
        or
        (
          "football"."competitions"."name_ru" is not null
          and "football"."competitions"."name_ru_review_status" is not null
          and "football"."competitions"."name_ru_review_status" in ('unreviewed', 'reviewed')
        )
      )

match_lineup_entries_provider_player_ide.name: match_lineup_entries_provider_player_identity_check
match_lineup_entries_provider_player_ide.value: "football"."match_lineup_entries"."provider_player_id" is not null or "football"."match_lineup_entries"."provider_player_name" is not null

match_lineups_coach_identity_check.name: match_lineups_coach_identity_check
match_lineups_coach_identity_check.value: "football"."match_lineups"."coach_id" is null or "football"."match_lineups"."provider_coach_id" is not null

players_name_ru_review_consistency_check.name: players_name_ru_review_consistency_check
players_name_ru_review_consistency_check.value:
(
        ("football"."players"."name_ru" is null and "football"."players"."name_ru_review_status" is null)
        or
        (
          "football"."players"."name_ru" is not null
          and "football"."players"."name_ru_review_status" is not null
          and "football"."players"."name_ru_review_status" in ('unreviewed', 'reviewed')
        )
      )

standings_statistics_nonnegative_check.name: standings_statistics_nonnegative_check
standings_statistics_nonnegative_check.value:
"football"."standings"."played" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."wins" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."draws" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."losses" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."goals_for" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."goals_against" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."home_played" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."home_wins" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."home_draws" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."home_losses" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."home_goals_for" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."home_goals_against" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."away_played" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."away_wins" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."away_draws" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."away_losses" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."away_goals_for" >= 0
        and "football"."standings"."away_goals_against" >= 0

media_assets_content_check.name: media_assets_content_check
media_assets_content_check.value: "media"."assets"."mime_type" = 'image/webp' and "media"."assets"."byte_size" between 1 and 5242880 and "media"."assets"."width" between 1 and 512 and "media"."assets"."height" between 1 and 512 and "media"."assets"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

admin_requests_scope_check.name: admin_requests_scope_check
admin_requests_scope_check.value:
(
    ("jobs"."admin_requests"."job_type" in ('football.sync-serie-a-foundation', 'football.sync-serie-a-matches',
      'football.sync-serie-a-standings', 'football.sync-serie-a-squads', 'football.sync-serie-a-player-statistics')
      and "jobs"."admin_requests"."match_id" is null)
    or ("jobs"."admin_requests"."job_type" in ('football.sync-serie-a-match-events', 'football.sync-serie-a-match-lineups',
      'football.sync-serie-a-match-statistics') and "jobs"."admin_requests"."match_id" is not null)
  )

executions_owner_lease_consistency_check.name: executions_owner_lease_consistency_check
executions_owner_lease_consistency_check.value:
(
        ("jobs"."executions"."status" = 'running' and "jobs"."executions"."claimed_by" is not null and "jobs"."executions"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or
        ("jobs"."executions"."status" <> 'running' and "jobs"."executions"."claimed_by" is null and "jobs"."executions"."lease_expires_at" is null)
      )
